wet.purpose: Predeclared72h initial land-water sensitivity and daily spinup, not calibration
wet.initial: Same previous post-conversion atmospheric T/water and globally balanced open-mean source wind. Surface starts from archived simulated ground temperature reduced to sea level with fixed6K/km; initial transfer rain and actual liquidH returned before run, excluded from run rain.

omitted_upper.description: Fixed exterior isothermal emitting slab above380hPa. T from initial6K/km source profile at p_top/2 with200K floor; dry tau uses declared dry opacity times omitted pressure mass. DownwardLW=sigma*T^4*(1-exp(-tau_above)). This is an externally maintained partial-column boundary, NOT TOA.

wet.forcing: Daily-mean Earth-orbit solar at evolving source day, prescribed25% outside reflection and drySW attenuation through omitted upper air; greyLW depth=kappa_dry*Md+.025*W, updates with actual vapor. Neutral loglaw at explicit initial pressure-derived reference height; signed dew/evap; finite liquid/heat reservoir. No forced temperature restoration.
wet.paired_control: Same forcing physics/parameters, T/vapor, source wind, orbit and lateral fields. Wet starts with50kg/m² land liquid, dry with0, plus separately returned initial pressure-conversion rain. Wet900/450 timestep comparison; dry900 is coarse sensitivity screen, not dry-branch numerical acceptance.
wet.approximation: Exploratory grey optical depths and neutral roughness are declared choices, not measured or Earth-fitted opacities. No clouds/spectral scattering, surface stability/gusts, ice/runoff/deep heating, terrain or nonlinear momentum. Daily-mean rather than diurnal forcing. Partial upper boundary and lateral fields held externally.
wet.energy_water: All actual vapor enthalpy/sensible exchange debited from finite surface; phase/dynamic rain returns mass and actual liquidH exactly once and changes surface heat capacity. Total gas+kinetic+surface E changes only by declared radiation/top/lateral power; total atmospheric+surfacewater changes only by lateral vapor transport.
wet.failure: Reject exhausted surface/airwater or out-of-domain temperatures; preserve all failures/partials; no parameter changes, clipped sources, replacement cases or adaptive post-outcome tuning.
wet.counts: This wet plan starts 6 new 72h Earth-input smoke runs. Both literal plans together start 9 after prior 66 starts/62 completions/four retained failures; expected cumulative 75 starts if all start. No new legacy benchmark attempts or strict passes.
wet.daily_checkpoints: Save actual states and day-specific rainfall at24/48/72h. Compare wet day1 against previous24h same-dt result to check orchestration reproducibility. Last-day statistics use fixed48–72h window only when complete. No steady-state or monthly-skill claim.
wet.initial_condition_scope: Land liquid is uncertain initial storage, not a fitted rainfall parameter or inferred soil truth. Ocean10m liquid/heat reservoir unchanged. No physical parameters changed between wet/dry. No post-outcome parameter adaptation or replacement cases.

publication.scope: Frozen inputs checked; saved daily energy/water budgets reconstructed against recorded net exterior supply. Day-three48–72h window, not equilibrium or monthly skill. Dry900 is a coarse initial-condition screen; wet900/450 quantify timestep sensitivity.

water_budget_maps.interpretation: Evaporation inferred from actual surface rain/mass change. Horizontal water import inferred from actual atmospheric+surface column storage change; all internal rain/evap cancels. This is net convergence, not moisture-origin attribution.
